executive_summary: Overnight Iranian aerial attacks struck a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain while Saudi air defenses intercepted multiple Houthi ballistic missiles across the Kingdom and two commercial tankers sustained projectile hits in the Strait of Hormuz.

regional_sections.summary:
Corroborated — Overnight Iranian aerial attacks struck a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain.
Corroborated — Two commercial tankers sustained projectile hits in the Strait of Hormuz.
Attributed — Saudi air defenses intercepted multiple Houthi ballistic missiles across the Kingdom.
Verified Official — The IDF said it struck a rocket launcher on the outskirts of Nabatieh in southern Lebanon.

advisory_highlights: No new official travel or embassy advisories were recorded in the last 24 hours.
